title: Make 'basic active management' a STANDARD for real-money legs: a CI guard that refuses a real-money/prop roster leg without (a) a declared trail with a computable activation R, (b) a TP-doctrine grade or a dated visible exemption line, (c) a coverage-matrix row
note: Operator 2026-10-28: '...so that we can start implementing it as a standard for real money strategies'. Today the standard is implicit: every real-money leg happens to declare a trail (MEASURED 7 of 7, config/strategies.yaml 2026-10-28) but nothing refuses a new real-money leg without one. Shape: scripts/ci/check_active_mgmt_standard.py + run_guards entry + tests with positive/negative controls, reading config/accounts.yaml rosters (re-parse; never hard-code counts) and config/strategies.yaml; ratchet baseline like tp-doctrine-guard. Tier 1 (CI). Adding a leg to the baseline for a real-money/prop routing is the operator's act. Cost ~$8.
